sovereign_identity.description: Distributed Server Substrate & Metal Compute Allocation Engine

file_management.law_1_epistemic_integrity: All file mutations must be backed by SHA-256 state hashes and recorded in the Merkle lineage ledger.
file_management.law_2_bounded_state: Ephemeral telemetry logs must roll over with a hard cap of 100 entries to prevent memory exhaustion.
file_management.law_3_fail_closed: Missing or corrupted configuration files trigger an immediate fail-closed state rather than default fallbacks.

process_management.law_1_zero_spawning: No transactional endpoints may invoke child processes per request; all execution occurs in persistent daemons.
process_management.law_2_substrate_first_lifecycle: Layer 1 Substrate/Memory -> Layer 2 Socket Handshake -> Layer 3 API Gateway -> Layer 4 Workstation UI.
process_management.law_3_persistent_stratum: Stratum mining sockets must maintain permanent TCP streaming with SO_KEEPALIVE without synthetic placeholders.
